assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: A large circle with centre O and radius 8 and its horizontal diameter A'A dashed in red; a blue circle of radius 4 inside it, with centre C, passes through O and touches the large circle at T; the angle alpha at O between OA and OT, the angle 2 alpha at C between CT and CP, and the point P of the small circle lying on the diameter, directly below T.

difficulty_rationale: Seeing that the small circle passes through the centre of the large one, and combining the rolling condition with an inscribed angle, is a genuine insight (the Tusi couple).
